voicerec.label.result: What you recorded — listen, then download
voicerec.status.idle: Hit start and your browser will ask to use the microphone. Nothing gets uploaded anywhere.
voicerec.err.unsupported: This browser cannot record. Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Safari.
voicerec.err.denied: The microphone is not available. Allow microphone access from the lock icon in the address bar.
voicerec.say.recording: Recording. If the bars move, sound is coming in.
voicerec.err.empty: Nothing was captured. Check that the right microphone is selected.
voicerec.say.silent: Captured {len}, but there is almost no sound. The mic may be muted, or another device may be selected.
voicerec.say.clipped: Captured {len}. It may be clipped though — try speaking a little further away.
voicerec.err.encode: Something went wrong while making the file: {msg}
voicerec.file.name: recording
